## 环境与初始材料
普通用户Linux、Nginx与Python3。提供nginx.conf安全运行骨架（当前所有请求501）和必要文件；原生Nginx必须前台、1worker、仅监听127.0.0.1:@PORT@，pid/日志/所有临时目录位于@ROOT@。验收将@PORT@替换随机高端口、@ROOT@替换独立临时目录、@UPSTREAM@替换本题回环源站。禁止修改系统Nginx或监听80/443。

## 操作任务
将/ready精确匹配为200纯文本ready换行；其他路径从@ROOT@/site读取文件，现有index.html和动态新增文件必须返回实际字节。HEAD与GET Content-Length一致但无响应体；不存在路径404，/ready/extra不得被就绪接口吞掉。不得开启目录浏览；/empty/应403或404。

## 提交产物
完整nginx.conf，保留安全运行骨架，使用原生Nginx指令实现；不得伪造固定响应冒充静态文件、代理或缓存结果。

title: 编写Nginx路由清单编译器：真实URI替换、最长前缀与原始编码路径保留
body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root Linux、真实Nginx与Python3。实现render.py，将受控路由清单编译成完整Nginx配置模板；不访问外部网络。原生实例仅允许1worker、前台、回环@PORT@高端口，PID/日志/临时目录位于@ROOT@；保留既有骨架。

## 操作任务
render(routes)返回完整配置字符串；routes为1..16项列表，每项恰含prefix/mode/port。prefix是不超过120字符且匹配`/(?:[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*/)+`的字面路径，必须唯一；mode仅strip或keep；port为1024..65535的非bool整数，源站只固定127.0.0.1。拒绝配置注入、其他字段、重复prefix和所有非法数据。
按prefix字典序确定性输出location。strip的proxy_pass携带URI `/`，替换匹配到的规范化前缀；keep不带URI，保留原始请求URI。两者保持方法、正文和非空query。允许嵌套路由，由真实Nginx最长前缀选择；没有匹配时404、不请求源站。原生自动为缺尾斜杠目录返回301，不自行代理或声称404。恰好目录、嵌套前缀、重复query、POST二进制正文及%2F编码路径均需符合原生规则：strip发送规范化路径如a/b；keep在本题没有rewrite的情形保留a%2Fb。
配置模板中的@ROOT@/@PORT@由可信验收替换；其余值不能引入任何未声明占位符、外部host、额外监听或系统路径。输入对象不得修改。`python3 render.py routes.json`在stdout只输出该模板，非法输入退出2且仅stderr报错，输入文件不可修改；重复JSON键/过深非法JSON均拒绝。

## 提交产物
render.py；生成的nginx.conf由可信验收接收并用真实Nginx运行，不以Python模拟URI路由。

## 验收方法
编译清单，执行真实nginx -t，再与两个独立回环HTTP源站联测，逐请求检查实际源站URI、方法、二进制正文和命中源站计数；第二套端口/嵌套前缀防止硬编码。覆盖非法清单、顺序不变性、JSON错误和输入保留，运行四路与独立突变。

## 能力边界
本题限定字面前缀和HTTP本地源站，不处理regex location、rewrite、变量proxy_pass、Service发现、生产入口或任意URL规范化；不能将有限编译器声称为完整Nginx解析器。

import pathlib,contextlib,socket,subprocess,time,signal,http.client,http.server,threading,json,re,secrets,gzip,concurrent.futures,os
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def freeport():
    with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return s.getsockname()[1]
def request(port,path='/',method='GET',body=None,headers=None,chunked=False):
    c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=3)
    try:
        c.request(method,path,body=body,headers=headers or {},encode_chunked=chunked)
        r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(),{k.lower():v for k,v in r.getheaders()}
    finally:c.close()
@contextlib.contextmanager
def origin(delay=0):
    records=[];lock=threading.Lock()
    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self,*args):pass
        def serve(self):
            data=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
            with lock:
                item={'path':self.path,'method':self.command,'length':len(data),'body':data.hex(),'sequence':len(records)+1};records.append(item)
            if delay:time.sleep(delay)
            content=json.dumps(item).encode();self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(content)));self.send_header('Cache-Control','public,max-age=30');self.end_headers()
            try:self.wfile.write(content)
            except OSError:pass
        do_GET=do_POST=do_PUT=serve
    server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);server.daemon_threads=False
    t=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,kwargs={'poll_interval':.01});t.start()
    try:yield server.server_port,records
    finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();t.join(1);assert not t.is_alive()
@contextlib.contextmanager
def nginx(values=None):
    values=dict(values or {});port=freeport();values['PORT']=port;values['ROOT']=str(ROOT)
    config=pathlib.Path('nginx.conf').read_text()
    for key,value in values.items():config=config.replace('@'+key+'@',str(value))
    assert not re.search(r'@[A-Z]+@',config),'unresolved placeholder'
    assert re.search(r'\bdaemon\s+off\s*;',config) and re.search(r'\bworker_processes\s+1\s*;',config)
    endpoints=re.findall(r'\blisten\s+([^;\s]+)',config);assert endpoints and all(p=='127.0.0.1:'+str(port) for p in endpoints)
    for directive in ['pid','error_log','client_body_temp_path','proxy_temp_path','fastcgi_temp_path','uwsgi_temp_path','scgi_temp_path']:
        match=re.search(r'\b'+directive+r'\s+([^;\s]+)',config);assert match and pathlib.Path(match[1]).is_relative_to(ROOT),directive
    pathlib.Path('rendered.conf').write_text(config);command=['nginx','-p',str(ROOT)+'/', '-c',str(ROOT/'rendered.conf')]
    syntax=subprocess.run(command+['-t'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3);assert syntax.returncode==0,syntax.stderr
    log=open('nginx-process.log','wb');p=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=log)
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            assert p.poll() is None,pathlib.Path('nginx-process.log').read_text(errors='replace')
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.02):break
            except OSError:time.sleep(.01)
        else:raise AssertionError('not listening')
        yield port
    finally:
        if p.poll() is None:p.send_signal(signal.SIGQUIT)
        try:p.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait(timeout=1)
        log.close();assert p.returncode==0,p.returncode



import copy,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from render import render

def compile_routes(routes,valid=True,raw=None):
    snapshot=copy.deepcopy(routes)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path=pathlib.Path(tmp)/'route plan.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(routes) if raw is None else raw,encoding='utf8')
        before=path.read_bytes()
        p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'render.py'),str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
        assert path.read_bytes()==before,'compiler modified input file'
        if not valid:
            assert p.returncode==2 and not p.stdout and p.stderr,(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
            return
        assert p.returncode==0,(p.stdout,p.stderr)
        try:direct=render(routes)
        except ValueError as error:raise AssertionError('valid routing plan rejected') from error
        assert direct==p.stdout and routes==snapshot
        return p.stdout

with origin() as (a,records_a), origin() as (b,records_b):
    routes=[{'prefix':'/strip/','mode':'strip','port':a},{'prefix':'/keep/','mode':'keep','port':a},
            {'prefix':'/api/','mode':'strip','port':a},{'prefix':'/api/admin/','mode':'keep','port':b}]
    compiled=compile_routes(routes)
    assert compile_routes(list(reversed(routes)))==compiled,'compiler output must be deterministic'
    pathlib.Path('nginx.conf').write_text(compiled)
    with nginx() as port:
        tests=[('/strip/orders?x=1','/orders?x=1',False),('/keep/orders?x=1','/keep/orders?x=1',False),
               ('/strip/','/',False),('/keep/','/keep/',False),('/api/report','/report',False),
               ('/api/admin/status?x=1','/api/admin/status?x=1',True),
               ('/strip/a%2Fb?q=%2F','/a/b?q=%2F',False),('/keep/a%2Fb?q=%2F','/keep/a%2Fb?q=%2F',False),
               ('/strip/x?a=&a=2','/x?a=&a=2',False)]
        for incoming,expected,use_b in tests:
            before=(len(records_a),len(records_b))
            status,data,headers=request(port,incoming);actual=json.loads(data)
            assert status==200 and actual['path']==expected,(incoming,actual)
            assert (len(records_a),len(records_b))==(before[0]+(not use_b),before[1]+use_b),'incorrect upstream'
        for prefix in ['strip','keep']:
            payload=b'\x00\xffreal body'
            status,data,headers=request(port,'/'+prefix+'/submit?q=2','POST',payload)
            result=json.loads(data)
            assert status==200 and result['method']=='POST' and result['body']==payload.hex()
            assert result['path']==('/submit?q=2' if prefix=='strip' else '/keep/submit?q=2')
        before=(len(records_a),len(records_b))
        for path in ['/unknown','/apix/secret','/api-admin/']:
            assert request(port,path)[0]==404
        assert request(port,'/strip')[0]==301,'native prefix-directory redirect'
        assert (len(records_a),len(records_b))==before,'unmatched/redirected path hit upstream'

# A second live topology proves ports and prefixes are not hardcoded.
with origin() as (a,records):
    routes=[{'prefix':'/team/nested/','mode':'strip','port':a}]
    pathlib.Path('nginx.conf').write_text(compile_routes(routes))
    with nginx() as port:
        status,data,_=request(port,'/team/nested/item?q=3')
        assert status==200 and json.loads(data)['path']=='/item?q=3'

# Inclusive schema boundaries are valid even when no service is running at a
# supplied upstream: compilation and nginx syntax do not claim its health.
upper=[{'prefix':'/r'+str(i)+'/','mode':'strip' if i%2 else 'keep','port':1024 if i==0 else 65535} for i in range(16)]
compile_routes(upper)
compile_routes([{'prefix':'/'+'a'*118+'/','mode':'keep','port':65535}])

for invalid in [None,{},[],[{'prefix':'/x/','mode':'keep','port':True}],
                [{'prefix':'/x/','mode':'keep','port':1023}],[{'prefix':'/x/','mode':'keep','port':65536}],
                [{'prefix':'/x/','mode':'unknown','port':12345}],
                [{'prefix':'/x/;return 200;','mode':'strip','port':12345}],
                [{'prefix':'/x//','mode':'strip','port':12345}],
                [{'prefix':'/','mode':'strip','port':12345}],
                [{'prefix':'/'+'a'*119+'/','mode':'strip','port':12345}],
                [{'prefix':'/x/','mode':'keep','port':12345,'extra':1}],
                [{'prefix':'/x/','mode':'keep','port':12345}]*2,
                [{'prefix':'/r'+str(i)+'/','mode':'keep','port':12345} for i in range(17)]]:
    compile_routes(invalid,False)
compile_routes([],False,raw='[{"prefix":"/a/","prefix":"/b/","mode":"keep","port":12345}]')
compile_routes([],False,raw='['*20000+'0'+']'*20000)
print('NGINX_NATIVE_ROUTE_COMPILER_OK')

## 环境与初始材料

## 操作任务
